en-US.promotionalText: Explore 132 styles and complete guides. Discover Rinpa, Cyanotype, Risograph and more, with bilingual learning, iPad layouts and saving images to Photos.
en-US.whatsNew:
Explore 12 new entries, bringing Style Atlas to 132 styles: Rinpa, Blue-and-white Porcelain, Chinese Paper-cut, Song Academy Bird-and-flower, Arts and Crafts, Mid-century Modern, Vienna Secession, Sachplakat, Risograph, Cyanotype, Linocut and Paper Collage.

Each addition includes a complete bilingual guide, guided observation, related-style comparisons and offline artwork. Improved iPad reading and sharing, including direct saving to Photos.

Style Atlas Plus offers monthly and annual auto-renewing subscriptions with localized prices and renewal terms shown by the App Store. No introductory offer or free trial is active.
en-US.descriptionCommerceCorrection:
Plus offers two auto-renewing plans:
• Monthly: auto-renews monthly at the localized App Store price until cancelled.
• Annual: auto-renews annually at the localized App Store price until cancelled.

The purchase screen shows the current localized price and renewal terms returned by the App Store. No introductory offer or free trial is active.

zh-Hans.promotionalText: 132 种艺术与设计风格，132 篇完整深度指南。新增琳派、蓝晒、Riso 等 12 种视觉语言；支持 iPad 并排阅读和图片保存到相册。
zh-Hans.whatsNew:
新增 12 种艺术与设计语言，图鉴扩展至 132 种：琳派、青花瓷装饰语汇、中国剪纸、宋代院体花鸟、工艺美术运动、世纪中期现代设计、维也纳分离派、物体海报、Riso 孔版印刷视觉、蓝晒、油毡版画、纸艺拼贴。

每种新增内容包含中英双语深度指南、观察引导、相近风格对照和离线图片。优化 iPad 阅读与分享，支持将图片直接保存到相册。

Style Atlas Plus 提供按月和按年自动续订，购买页显示 App Store 返回的当前本地价格与续费条款。当前没有首期优惠或免费试用。
zh-Hans.descriptionCommerceCorrection:
Plus 提供两种自动续订方案：
• 连续包月：按 App Store 显示的当前本地价格每月自动续订，可随时取消。
• 连续包年：按 App Store 显示的当前本地价格每年自动续订，可随时取消。

购买页会显示 App Store 返回的当前本地价格与续费条款。当前没有首期优惠或免费试用。

reviewNotes:
Style Atlas V1.6 (19) removes the previous introductory campaign and shows only the current standard StoreKit prices. No account or sign-in is required.

Monthly auto-renewal: US$9.99/month in the United States and CNY 19.90/month in mainland China. Annual auto-renewal: US$89.99/year in the United States and CNY 159/year in mainland China. The China price changes are scheduled for 2026-09-23, Apple's earliest available effective date. Other storefronts use their localized App Store prices. No introductory offer or free trial is active.

Suggested review path:
1. Tap a Plus-locked section or Open the complete style archive.
2. Review the annual option selected by default and its standard annual price.
3. Select the monthly option and review its standard monthly price.
4. Complete a sandbox purchase, then test Restore Purchases.
5. Test language switching, favorites, export ratios, device rotation, iPad resizing, Photos saving, widgets and the opt-in 9:00 AM local reminder.

StoreKit products:
- xiazishuo_style_atlas_plus_monthly_auto
- xiazishuo_style_atlas_plus_annual_auto

Legacy products remain recognized only for existing purchasers:
- xiazishuo_style_atlas_plus_annual
- xiazishuo_style_atlas_plus_lifetime

Purchases use StoreKit / the App Review test environment; no test account is required. Product IDs, subscription group and entitlement rules are unchanged.
